Get started
For Health Plans

Deliver behavioral health proven to work for all your members.

Partner with us
Trusted by leading health plans. Verified by experts.
Care that improves your members’ behavioral and physical health

Expand access to behavioral health that’s measurably better.

Built for outcomes, not just access

Backed by nearly a decade of outcomes data, Spring Health combines advanced technology and high- performing providers to drive reliable clinical results and lower total medical spend in as few as five to six sessions.

Providers that deliver great care, consistently

Every provider uses a single EHR built for behavioral healthcare so they can deliver personalized, measurement-based care in every interaction. Lasting clinical improvement for your members is now the norm. 

Care for every need, always within reach

Members can access timely therapy and medication for everything from everyday stress to complex conditions. Self-care tools help them stay on track between sessions and recover even faster.

Clinical and financial results plans can rely on

Addressing member mental health the right way prevents costly medical claims later.
